process_map: Order arrives from WordPress, phone or WhatsApp.
Operator records or confirms order row in central sheet.
Automation validates products against catalog and stock.
If stock is OK, confirmation draft is prepared.
If stock is low or missing, order is marked needs_review.
At day end, report summarizes sales, exceptions and replenishment needs.

automation_opportunities.name: Stock validation
automation_opportunities.impact: Reduces wrong confirmations and out-of-stock sales.

automation_opportunities.name: WhatsApp ingestion
automation_opportunities.impact: Useful later, but not required for phase 1.

recommended_automations: Google Sheets trigger for new/updated order rows
Catalog match and stock threshold check
Daily report scheduled at closing time

workflow_design.phase_1: Semi-automated deterministic workflow with operator approval for confirmations.
workflow_design.fallback: If automation fails, operator continues using the central sheet and marks exceptions manually.
